# PaintLab Commercial Systems

> Austin's premier commercial painting and coating contractor. Expert repaint systems for commercial real estate. Fixed-cost subscription maintenance plans available.

## Company Overview

PaintLab is a commercial painting and coating systems firm based in Austin, Texas. We specialize in high-durability refinishing for existing commercial assets — no new construction — just elite restoration and protection for commercial properties across Austin and Central Texas.

Founded by Scott Gendelman, a commercial operator with over 20 years of experience across technology, business development, operations, and marketing. PaintLab was built to solve the chronic challenges in the commercial painting market: unreliable vendors, uneven quality, unclear pricing, and constant friction in execution.

**Phone:** (512) 484-3124  
**Email:** hello@paintlabpro.com  
**Location:** Austin, Texas  
**Service Area:** Austin, Central Texas (Round Rock, Cedar Park, Kyle, San Marcos, and surrounding areas)  
**License:** Licensed, insured, OSHA compliant  
**Guarantee:** 2-year guarantee on all work performed

## Services

### Commercial Repaint Systems
Expert repaint and recoat projects for commercial properties. Substrate evaluation, system specification, and coordinated execution with minimal operational disruption.

### PaintLab Autopilot Subscription
Austin's first fixed-cost painting utility for commercial assets. Monthly subscription plans for ongoing managed maintenance — covering common areas, exteriors, interiors, and specialty zones. Available for:
- Multi-Family / Apartment Communities
- Office & Corporate Buildings
- Retail, Hotels & Restaurants
- Medical & Healthcare Facilities
- Industrial & Warehouse
- Automotive Dealerships & Service Centers
- Education & K-12 / University Campuses
- Gyms & Fitness Centers

### Coating System Types
- Exterior painting (masonry, EIFS, metal, wood)
- Interior commercial painting (walls, ceilings, trim)
- Epoxy floor coatings and floor systems
- Specialty coatings (anti-graffiti, ESD, chemical-resistant)
- Deck and waterproofing systems
- Sealants and caulking

## Sectors Served
Multi-Family Residential, Office, Retail, Medical/Healthcare, Warehouse & Distribution, Industrial/Manufacturing, Education, Automotive, Data Centers
